analysis.description: This paper introduces a model merging approach called Non-Uniform Parameter-Wise Model Merging (NP Merge). The method allows for more precise control over how each model parameter contributes to the merged output by using gradient-based optimization. NP Merge is designed to improve performance when merging models of different architectures or data distributions, outperforming previous uniform parameter averaging approaches. It also offers scalability and robustness for merging multiple models throughout federated learning scenarios.
